name: @dyzsasd/writing-loop
description: An autonomous short-drama (vertical micro-drama) writers' room in a folder — nine agents plan, outline, write, review, score, and market-watch scripts through a local file board. Includes a zero-dependency scheduler, a loopback-only multi-project Studio UI, stable JSON snapshots, live agent run state, project controls, fires telemetry, and the full writing-loop plugin payload. Fires agents on Claude Code, Codex, or opencode.
